audit.whatIsWrong: The page puts Quinn's blind on Vault (E) in five places — 'Vault (Dash/Blind)', 'her E vaults her backward and blinds', 'bait her E knockback/blind'. Riot's text for Vault is a dash that damages, slows, briefly interrupts and lands her back at attack range; the blind belongs to Blinding Assault (Q), 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s.
audit.why: It changes what you dodge and what you bait. Blinding Assault is the ability that makes your Staggering Blow auto whiff, so the root never procs; Vault is the escape you have to bait before committing the hook. Baiting the wrong one gets you killed.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault (Q) blinds your passive auto from 1025 range; Vault (E) is the 675-range escape dash on 12/11/10/9/8s.
sources: champ-data/_kits/quinn.json (Q 'hinder its vision', E text and cooldowns)

audit.whatIsWrong: Behind Enemy Lines is never mentioned as a channel, so the page never tells the player they can cancel it.
audit.why: Quinn's R is flagged channel — interruptible by any CC. Staggering Blow, Dredge Line or Depth Charge cancels it outright, which is how you punish a Quinn trying to leave lane or reposition mid-fight.
audit.corrected: Stated in mid: her Behind Enemy Lines is a channel and any CC of yours cancels it.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are miserable: Quinn's whole kit exists to beat mine. Her E vaults her backward and blinds while her Harrier passive gives a burst of move speed, so the moment I step up to throw Q Dredge Line she sidesteps it — and Q is my ONLY gap-close, so a whiffed one leaves me naked for her empowered-auto poke. Don't chase the Q. Last-hit at max range, eat the chip, and accept that my passive root and W splash burn mean nothing if I can never touch her.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are miserable: Quinn's whole kit exists to beat yours. Blinding Assault (Q) blinds your Staggering Blow auto from 1025 range, and Vault (E) leaps her back out to attack range the moment you step up — and Dredge Line is your ONLY gap-close, so a whiff leaves you naked for her Harrier-empowered poke. Don't chase the hook. Last-hit at max range, eat the chip, and accept that your root and splash burn mean nothing until you can touch her.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay rough — she scales her poke and I still can't land Q on a target that vaults — but Level 6 is my one real window. Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so unlike Q it ignores her E knockback: ult her, ride it into E-passive-root, and chain Q-pull-into-R-knockup to delete her before she kites out. That's the whole gameplan. Bait her E onto a minion or a fake step first; if her vault is down when I ult, she has no escape and I get my only kill of the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay rough — she scales her poke and you still cannot hook a target that vaults — but level 6 is your one real window. Depth Charge homes and cannot be dodged, so unlike the hook it catches her through Vault: ult her, ride it into the passive root, then pull and Riptide before she kites out. Bait Vault onto a minion first — it is 12s at rank 1. Behind Enemy Lines is a channel too, so any CC of yours cancels it outright.

Play this as a teamfight CC-bot: save R for her or her carry, peel, and let my team punish her — I will not win the sidelane.
edits.after: Late game you are a tank with no target. Quinn never stands in your Riptide waves, never walks into hook range, and her Harrier kite plus roam and splitpush keeps her out of lane entirely. Your damage is flat and tank-only while she burst-kites from full range, so you do not 1v1 her past two items. Play teamfight CC-bot: save Depth Charge for her or her carry, peel, and let your team punish her.
